title: Anthropic signs multi-gigawatt Google TPU deal, reportedly worth $200B over five years

sources.quote: We have signed a new agreement with Google and Broadcom for multiple gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity that we expect to come online starting in 2027.
Anthropic has committed to spend $200 billion with Google Cloud over five years as part of a recent agreement, The Information reported on Tuesday, citing a person with knowledge of the matter.

explain: Anthropic agreed to rent several gigawatts of Google's TPU AI chips (designed with Broadcom), coming online from 2027. Anthropic gave no price; The Information reported Anthropic committed to spend $200 billion with Google Cloud over five years, which would be a large share of Google Cloud's backlog.
